subject.title: fix: allow preflight compaction to reenter session locks

question: Is the earlier live allowReentrant hotfix proof acceptable for this materially revised logical-writer implementation, or must the exact current head be rerun against the long-session compaction scenario?
rationale: The production evidence strongly validates the user problem and general reentry strategy, but it does not prove that the revised AsyncLocalStorage ownership context is present in the real failing path; repository policy makes real behavior proof a merge gate for this external PR.

options.title: Require exact-head live proof
options.body: Rerun the affected Telegram or equivalent channel session using head 6343a47b7a5627061f6442b1e0c7b4f9259d786c and capture redacted successful compaction output and lock diagnostics.

options.title: Apply a proof override
options.body: Accept the earlier live hotfix evidence plus the new behavior-level tests as sufficient because the revised implementation intentionally narrows the same reentry behavior.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head live proof
